revision_rule.note: The 2012 rule says the bind-associated mapping shall influence bound-instantiation elaboration, but does not require that mapping to determine target-scope selection; it still requires target-instance mapping to be ignored.

The 2017 rule only says the bind-associated mapping influences bound-instantiation elaboration; it does not require that mapping to select the target scope or specify cell-selection-equivalent treatment.
In 2012, a module-item parameter remains a nonlocal overrideable parameter even when the module has a parameter_port_list; 2012 does not apply the later rule treating it as local.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not contain the guarantee that module-item parameters become local whenever a parameter-port list exists.

The 2012 hierarchy-branch rule covers module and generate instances, tasks, functions, and named blocks, but does not include the 2023 guarantees that assertion labels and named assertion action blocks create hierarchy branches.
